hooks.logic:
Let ability be the id of the move labelled list2 on the enemy.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "doom" on the enemy.
Count up "turnInGlobal".
Count up "turnInSpecial".
If the count check passes, then
  Let v be the value "abilityId" of the last move of the enemy.
  If ability contains v, then
    Set the register's 'specialAbilityTag' to call game:ai.AiUtil.getAbilityTagById with (the enemy, v, list2).
    Choose state 21 next and stop.
If not (call game:AbilityMgr.getInstance) → exists-registered-interrupt-ability and the enemy can act, then
  If the register's 'currBattlePhase' is 1 and the HP fraction of the enemy is at most 60, then choose state 31 next and stop.
  If the enemy is ready to act, then
    Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
    If the register's 'turnInSpecial' is less than 2, then set withoutAbilityList to withoutAbilityList → concat with (ability).
    If the register's 'turnInGlobal' is less than 10, then append ability2 to withoutAbilityList.
    The enemy → lot-and-register-ability-without with (withoutAbilityList).

hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let currBattlePhase be the register's 'currBattlePhase'.
Let specialAbilityTag be the register's 'specialAbilityTag'.
Reset the count "turnInSpecial".
Set the state settings's 'paramId' to data at currBattlePhase at specialAbilityTag.
Set the state settings's 'sa' to [].
If specialAbilityTag is "diluvial_plague", then set the state settings's 'sa' to list.
Call arg.
